title: Operations Record Contracts (Non-Normative)
description: Current implementation binding for strict canonical operations records used by leadership decision lineage and protected activation. This schema is not a sixth portable qualification schema. Candidate manifests, test plans, evidence records, threshold policies, and verdict records remain governed only by the five portable v2.0.1 schemas. Apply this schema to the operations-record subset of a mixed canonical record index.
$comment: JSON Schema cannot recompute content digests, compare cross-record references, prove attestation signatures, enforce unique recordId values across an array, compare timestamps, or authorize a write. Test-OperationsBlueprint.ps1 and protected-environment controls must enforce those semantic and authorization properties.

privateDocumentRef.$comment: Whole protected document reference. Fragments are forbidden so sourceRecordDigest always commits the complete portable source; field selection occurs only through separately validated JSON Pointers.

canonicalPrincipalId.$comment: Privacy-safe immutable pseudonym for a canonical directory principal. Raw tenant object identifiers, display names, aliases, and reversible encodings are forbidden.

wholeRecordDigestBinding.$comment: Exact whole-record identity and content commitment. Fragments are forbidden; semantic resolution must reject duplicate recordRef values even when paired with different digests.

targetPopulationBinding.$comment: The semantic validator must prove targetPopulationCount is no greater than populationCeiling, exclusions plus the group-membership rule and assignment filter resolve exactly to the directory readback, and a dynamic readback remains current at write time. assignmentFilterMode NONE still requires a signed canonical NONE binding through assignmentFilterRef and assignmentFilterDigest; null or omitted filters are forbidden.

canonicalEnvelope.$comment: envelopeCoreDigest is SHA-256 over canonical JSON for recordId, recordType, contentDigest, validated, freshness, validFrom, validUntil, pointers, and immutableArtifactRef. The semantic validator must recompute it and require attestationSubjectDigest to equal envelopeCoreDigest; JSON Schema cannot compare sibling values.

fleetPortfolioFreshnessPolicyValue.$comment: Typed operations overlay for the portable threshold-policy extension at /extensions/leadershipFreshness/currentFleetIssue. The portable schema remains unchanged; the semantic validator must resolve this exact pointed value from the frozen threshold-policy record, validate it against this closed shape, and bind its canonical digest and scalar maximum to every fleet-portfolio freshness consumer.

fleetPortfolioFreshnessBinding.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve policyRef as the exact frozen portable threshold-policy record with policyDigest; require that record and digest to equal the Phase 0 test plan's thresholdPolicyRef and canonical digest; resolve policyObjectPointer as /extensions/leadershipFreshness/currentFleetIssue; validate the pointed object against fleetPortfolioFreshnessPolicyValue; recompute policyObjectDigest; require maximumAgePointer and maximumAgeDays to equal its exact governed scalar; and reject caller-selected wider ages or alternate policies. It must resolve platformBaselineRef as the exact current platform-baseline-record with platformBaselineDigest; require those fields to equal the canonical platform-baseline reference and digest admitted by currentFleetIssue; require platformBaselinePointer and dependencySnapshotPointer to select /dependencySnapshot; require dependencySnapshotRef to equal <platformBaselineRef>#/dependencySnapshot; recompute dependencySnapshotDigest over the exact seven-field snapshot; and require MATCH plus observation/admission/window/age chronology. Broader fleet baselineFingerprint equality is enforced separately and must not be replaced by the dependency snapshot digest.

unitRef.$comment: Privacy-safe one-way unit pseudonym; raw serials, hostnames, directory identifiers, and reversible aliases are forbidden.

portableCorroborationReference.$comment: Exact projection of the portable evidence-record corroborationRef object. The semantic validator must resolve recordRef to a distinct full portable T0 or T1 evidence record, validate it through its own current portable-contract validation and projection records, and require expectedProvenance and claimScope to match that source exactly.

portableProjectionBinding.$comment: One exact JSON Pointer projection from a full portable source. value is admitted only after protected resolution of the source digest and successful validation against the exact schema digest; valueDigest is the canonical SHA-256 of value. The semantic validator must reject duplicate pointers and require byte-for-byte canonical equality with the resolved source value.

projectionField.$comment: Stable operations-view field name. It is not inferred from the pointer token; the semantic validator requires ordinal uniqueness and the portable-type branch's exact closed field set.

candidateManifestProjectionBindings.$comment: Closed operations projection vocabulary for a fully validated portable candidate manifest. Required fields are always present; conditional fields are admitted only when the full source contains the exact pointed value.

testPlanProjectionBindings.$comment: Exact closed Phase 0 test-plan view; canonical planId is bound separately by sourceCanonicalIdPointer/value.

evidenceRecordProjectionBindings.$comment: Closed evidence view. The required fields are normative portable evidence fields. Optional operations aliases may point only to exact source values, including values under extensions, and remain subject to consumer-specific semantic validation.

qualificationAuthorityApprovalPayload.$comment: A signed, non-self-authorizing approval for one scope-specific portable verdict decision. It is evidence only and authorizationEffect is always NONE. The semantic validator must resolve the exact manifest projection and its tenant/environment anchors, the exact verdict canonical ID, a current role-binding/readback closure, and each approver's exact role/principal pair. authorityPrincipalId, every approver, recordProducerPrincipalId, affectedRequesterPrincipalId, role-binding source/read actors, and protected validation actors must satisfy the operation-wide separation policy. approverSetDigest is the canonical digest of the ordinally unique approverBindings set. To avoid a digest cycle, verdictRef has no full verdict digest: decisionSubjectDigest commits the scope-specific verdict subject after removing every approval ref/digest, and approvalSubjectDigest commits the complete immutable approval subject including decisionSubjectDigest. signedSubjectDigest must equal approvalSubjectDigest. PRODUCTION resolution must verify the signature, artifact, current revocation, freshness, and protected sources before this record can support any downstream gate; the record itself never authorizes that gate.

portableContractValidationPayload.$comment: Admission evidence for one full portable record, never an authorization. PRODUCTION VERIFIED requires an authenticated protected source resolver, exact source/schema/validator digests, a cryptographically VERIFIED attestation whose subject is validationResultDigest, current MATCH freshness, and successful validation of the entire source document against the immutable portable schema. TEST permits only SYNTHETIC resolver and attestation status and remains non-authorizing. validationInputDigest is the canonical digest of the ordered object {portableRecordType,sourceRecordRef,sourceRecordDigest,schemaUri,schemaDigest,validatorReleaseRef,validatorReleaseDigest}. validationIssueSetDigest commits the exact ordinal validation issue array, including the empty array for VERIFIED. validationResultDigest is the canonical digest of the ordered object {status,validationInputDigest,validationIssueCount,validationIssueSetDigest,validatedAt,resolverStatus}.

portableContractProjectionPayload.$comment: A non-authoritative, typed view of one full portable source. This record replaces every thin canonical envelope that formerly used an authoritative portable recordType name. The semantic validator must resolve and authenticate the exact private source, require a current matching portable-contract-validation-record, require sourceCanonicalIdPointer/value to equal the full source, require projectionPointers to equal the ordinal pointer list in projection.bindings, require ordinally unique projectionField and pointer values, recompute every valueDigest from the exact pointed value, recompute projectionDigest over the ordered closed binding set, and reject duplicate/missing/nonexistent pointers or fields. Consumers must assert portableRecordType before using the closed projection and may not treat this admission record as a verdict, pilot, procurement, publication, or deployment authorization.

evidenceReleasePayload.$comment: An evidence release has two non-circular commitments. releaseSubjectDigest is SHA-256 over the canonical exact payload after excluding only memberRecordIds, memberRecordBindings, and releaseSubjectDigest; every other present payload field remains in that subject projection. The final envelope contentDigest then commits the complete payload, including releaseSubjectDigest and the ordered whole-record membership. The semantic validator must require memberRecordIds and memberRecordBindings to have equal length and order, require memberRecordIds[i] to equal memberRecordBindings[i].recordRef case-sensitively, reject duplicate recordRef values even with different digests, resolve every whole record, and require its exact digest. A same-ID replacement, fragment member, missing member, extra member, cross-wired digest, or altered release subject invalidates the release.

compatibilityCacheAdmissionPayload.$comment: A non-authorizing current admission for reuse of one immutable historical application-compatibility evidence record. The historical evidence and its original admission remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The semantic validator must resolve cachedEvidenceRef/cachedEvidenceDigest as that exact historical evidence and historicalEvidenceReleaseRef/historicalEvidenceReleaseDigest/historicalEvidenceReleaseSubjectDigest as its exact final release and stable subject; prove exact historical membership; resolve the current manifest, test plan, and threshold policy; resolve every ordinally unique bridge evidence and distribution binding, require exact paired back-references, and prove that the fresh bridge covers the cached claim's dependencies under the current baselines. currentConsumerRef is the whole record ID of the one application-compatibility distribution that consumes this admission and intentionally has no digest here, preventing a cycle; that distribution binds this admission's final digest. currentConsumerRef must be distinct from cachedEvidenceRef, every bridgeEvidenceBindings and bridgeDistributionBindings recordRef, both release IDs, and the admission record itself; in particular, the consumer distribution cannot also be a digest-bound bridge. currentEvidenceReleaseRef/currentEvidenceReleaseSubjectDigest bind the stable subject of the current release, whose final member bindings must include the admission, consumer distribution, and bridge records. freshnessPolicyRef, freshnessPolicyDigest, and freshnessMaxAgeMinutes must equal the roleBindingReadbackPolicyRef, roleBindingReadbackPolicyDigest, and roleBindingReadbackMaxAgeMinutes fields and govern current identity, authority, and revocation readback; the cached result's separate maximum age is taken only from the exact currentTestPlan evidenceReusePolicy.compatibilityCache.maximumAgeDays value. admissionSubjectDigest is the canonical digest of the entire exact payload excluding only admissionSubjectDigest, signedSubjectDigest, admissionArtifactRef, admissionArtifactDigest, attestationRef, attestationDigest, attestationSubjectDigest, attestationStatus, signatureRef, signatureDigest, and signatureStatus. The signer principal, key reference, SPKI digest, protected key-binding reference/digest/status/check time remain inside that signed subject. The validator must require signedSubjectDigest, admissionArtifactDigest, and attestationSubjectDigest to equal admissionSubjectDigest; require signatureSignerPrincipalId to equal issuedByPrincipalId; authenticate the exact current, non-revoked principal-to-key/SPKI binding through a protected resolver; cryptographically verify the artifact, attestation, and signature; resolve the exact ROLE_EVIDENCE_CUSTODY_OWNER role-binding/readback closure; enforce operation-wide principal separation, current freshness and revocation, and the chronology original evidence observation < original admission < historical release < every bridge observation < every bridge admission < bridgeAcceptedAt < admittedAt <= issuedAt < expiresAt; the current release must be issued only after admission. This record has authorizationEffect NONE and cannot itself authorize a verdict, pilot, purchase, or deployment.

businessCostDeltaPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve both commercial quote records, prove currency/quantity compatibility and quote freshness, require calculation.method to equal calculationMethod, calculation.result to equal calculationResult, and resultUnit to equal currency.

businessImpactPayload.$comment: Exactly one evidence posture is permitted. NOT_MEASURED is a controlled absence statement and cannot carry positive-effect fields.

distributionPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve sourceEvidenceRef and sourceEvidenceDigest as one exact evidence record and resolve sourceEvidenceReleaseRef as an exact release whose recomputed releaseSubjectDigest equals sourceEvidenceReleaseSubjectDigest. The distribution deliberately does not embed a final release contentDigest, because a final digest can commit this distribution's member digest. In the normal fresh-evidence branch, sourceEvidenceReleaseRef is the current release: both the evidence and this distribution must be exact members, and the evidence's evidenceReleaseRef and distributionRef back-references must agree with that release and this distribution. A compatibilityCacheAdmissionRef/Digest pair selects the only exception: it is permitted only on a newly created current application-compatibility consumer distribution and must resolve one exact ADMITTED compatibility-cache-admission record whose currentConsumerRef is this distribution's whole record ID. In that branch, sourceEvidenceRef/Digest and sourceEvidenceReleaseRef/SubjectDigest remain bound to the immutable historical evidence and historical release; the historical evidence retains its original admission and original distributionRef. The admission separately binds the historical release and the distinct current release, consumer, and bridges. The normal same-release and direct distributionRef back-reference requirements are waived only for this fully valid cache branch and never merely because the pair is present. The pair must never be added to or used to mutate the historical evidence or distribution. The admission contains no current-consumer digest, so its digest may safely be bound here without a cycle. All branches must reject same-ID content substitution through exact release member bindings. It must resolve phase0TestPlanRef and its exact digest; resolve testRef case-sensitively as exactly one testDefinition.testId in that frozen plan; recompute testDefinitionDigest over that canonical definition; and require the definition's class, class-specific legal phase, samplingFloorRef, test-pack version, condition membership, and appliesTo coverage to agree exactly with this distribution and its source evidence. Candidate/incumbent/sibling controlled-test evidence is Phase 3 and the source evidence role must be covered by appliesTo; generic distributions retain the portable plan's legal Phase 1, 2, 3, and 4 class mappings. conditionRef must equal one testDefinition.conditions[].conditionId and the source evidence condition; baselineFingerprint must equal the source evidence runtime baseline fingerprint, so unlike baselines cannot be silently joined. It must require perUnitRunCounts to contain exactly unitCount unique privacy-safe unitRef values, require every acceptedRunCount to meet the frozen requiredRuns per-unit floor, and require runCount to equal their sum; aggregate runs cannot conceal an under-tested unit. It must also require samplingFloorPointer to equal #/samplingFloors/<testClass>, recompute samplingFloorDigest over that canonical frozen floor, and require requiredUnits and requiredRuns to equal the frozen plan values. No class-only match, public minimum, or caller-supplied lower floor may substitute for the exact approved Phase 0 test definition and floor.

testRef.$comment: Case-sensitive testDefinition.testId, resolved uniquely inside the exact digest-bound Phase 0 test plan. This is an identifier, not a JSON Pointer.

conditionRef.$comment: Case-sensitive testCondition.conditionId in the resolved test definition and exact source-evidence condition binding.

renderManifestPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must recompute the source-record-set and output digests, prove every binding is present in the validated claim closure, and reject links, encodings, formats, or renderer inputs outside the signed policies.

phase2ApprovalPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve every digest binding, prove the two approvals use distinct authorized roles and principals, validate every current exception, and reject an approval outside the canonical envelope validity window.

roleBindingEntry.$comment: canonicalPrincipalId is an immutable private reference to the directory object identifier, not a display name or mutable alias. The semantic validator must require every roleId plus principalAliasRef pair to be unique and every alias to resolve to exactly one canonicalPrincipalId before recomputing bindingSetDigest.

rootAuthorityKeyBinding.$comment: publicKeySpkiDigest is the immutable SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo bytes, and keyCustodianPrincipalId is the privacy-safe immutable canonical principal that controls that key. Aliases alone never establish key or custodian uniqueness.

identityGovernanceRootAuthorityPayload.$comment: This is the non-recursive root-ceremony trust anchor for role-binding approval in v1.0.0. The semantic validator must recompute ceremonySubjectDigest and authorityKeySetDigest over the ordered normalized authorityKeyBindings including each keyCustodianPrincipalId; require quorumThreshold of at least two and no greater than both the unique SPKI-digest count and unique canonical key-custodian count; require at least quorumThreshold distinct VERIFIED signature key-ref/SPKI/signer triples drawn exactly from authorityKeyBindings; require every signerPrincipalId to equal the matched keyCustodianPrincipalId; require quorum across distinct signer canonical principals as well as distinct SPKIs; and require every signature signedSubjectDigest to equal ceremonySubjectDigest. All key custodians must be canonically separated from the ceremony operator, independent reader, role approver, and protected-operation principals. The validator must independently observe the immutable canonical root-authority subject, require independentReadbackSubjectDigest to equal the recomputed ceremonySubjectDigest, verify the independent readback attestation, prove chronology and revocation, enforce independentReadbackMaxAgeMinutes without accepting a caller-supplied wider bound, and forbid any role-binding approval from serving as its own authority.

roleBindingApprovalPayload.$comment: This specialized signed approval binds one versioned canonical role catalog to one exact binding set, tenant, and target environment. In v1.0.0 approvalAuthorityRef and approvalAuthorityDigest must resolve directly to one ACTIVE identity-governance-root-authority-record, while approvalAuthorityReadbackRef and approvalAuthorityReadbackDigest must exactly equal that root record's independently verified readback artifact. The semantic validator must recompute approvedRoleCatalogDigest and approvalSubjectDigest; require signatureAuthorityKeyRef plus signatureAuthorityPublicKeySpkiDigest to match exactly one immutable root-authority key binding; require signedSubjectDigest to equal approvalSubjectDigest; verify signature and artifact attestation; forbid self-bootstrap or delegated approval chains; require root-authority chronology and canonical identity separation; and reject expired or revoked approval.

approvedRoleCatalog.$comment: The semantic validator must require exact equality to the approved control-matrix role catalog for this release and reject invented, omitted, stale, or case-variant role identifiers.

roleBindingPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve each alias exactly once to its immutable canonical directory object identifier, require unique role/alias pairs, recompute bindingSetDigest over the canonical set, verify approval and revocation evidence, and require sourceIdentityRef to differ from the role-binding readback identity.

roleBindingReadbackPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve roleBindingRef and roleBindingDigest, require tenant, environment, canonical binding-set, and revocation equality, prove the reader identity is independent of the source identity, and reject observations older than maxAgeMinutes under the exact readback policy.

securityFreshnessPolicyPayload.$comment: The two authority branches are strict, mutually exclusive, and acyclic. ROOT_BOOTSTRAP is limited to an IDENTITY_ROLE_BINDING_READBACK / READBACK_FRESHNESS policy signed by an ACTIVE, unexpired, non-revoked identity-governance root-authority key; tenant and environment must match, rootAuthorityReadback fields must equal that root record's embedded independently attested readback artifact, its observation age must not exceed the root's independentReadbackMaxAgeMinutes, approvedByPrincipalRef must equal the root ceremonyOperatorIdentityRef, and the signature key-ref/SPKI pair must be an exact active root-key member. ROLE_BOUND is required for operational control-plane policies and resolves an exact current non-revoked role binding plus independent readback; approvedByPrincipalRef must hold ROLE_SECURITY_APPROVER in that binding, and the readback must itself be governed by a distinct APPROVED ROOT_BOOTSTRAP policy, never this policy or another ROLE_BOUND policy. The validator must reject self-reference and digest/reference equality across cycle-breaking edges. For APPROVED use it must recompute approvalSubjectDigest, require signedSubjectDigest equality, verify the artifact and signature, prove approvedAt <= evaluation time < expiresAt and a current NOT_REVOKED check no older than maximumAgeMinutes, and bind tenant, environment, contentDigest, policyKind, and maximumAgeMinutes exactly into every consumer.

packageVerificationPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve packageRevocationFreshnessPolicyRef and its digest, require revocationCheckedAt no older than packageRevocationCheckMaxAgeMinutes at evaluation time, and prove timestamp, revocation, verification, and expiration chronology before accepting VERIFIED.

writeAuthorizationPayload.$comment: A write authorization is immutable, single-use, and bound to one authorizedOperationId. The semantic validator must resolve issuedByPrincipalRef through the exact role binding as ROLE_PROTECTED_ENVIRONMENT_APPROVER; recompute authorizationSubjectDigest over the exact immutable payload excluding only authorizationSubjectDigest, issuerSignatureRef, issuerSignatureDigest, and issuerSignatureStatus; verify the bound artifact and issuer signature; reject reuse; prove issuedAt <= notBefore <= write start <= write completion < expiresAt; enforce expiresAt minus issuedAt no greater than authorizationMaxTtlMinutes; and require revocationCheckedAt to remain within authorizationRevocationCheckMaxAgeMinutes at evaluation time.

authorizationConsumptionPayload.$comment: This record is issued atomically by the authoritative consumption ledger. The semantic validator must verify the ledger authority and policy, the append-only previous-entry and sequence chain, the atomic commit evidence, exact authorization nonce/digest/operation binding, and absence of any other committed use.

authorizationConsumptionLedgerReadbackPa.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve the exact authorization-consumption and write-operation records, prove all authorization, nonce, operation, ledger sequence, previous/resulting digest, authority, policy, and atomic-commit bindings agree, require the reader tool and identity to be independent of ledger mutation, and reject an observation older than maxAgeMinutes.

writeOperationPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must prove startedAt <= consumedAt <= mutationStartedAt <= completedAt and require preNetworkAtomicCommitEvidenceRef/preNetworkAtomicCommitEvidenceDigest to equal the authoritative authorization-consumption atomic-commit evidence before any network mutation begins.

atmosStackRenderPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must prove source orders are unique and contiguous, usedOverrideKeys is a subset of declaredOverrideKeys, no undeclared override influenced the render, and renderedOutputDigest equals atmosRenderDigest in every bound reviewed plan and rollout-monitoring record.

azureDeploymentOperationPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must resolve the reviewed plan, generic single-use write authorization and operation, authoritative authorization consumption and independent ledger observation, role binding and independent role readback, and verified package. It must prove exact authorization and operation identity plus tenant, subscription, target environment, target scope, resource identifier, API version, source commit, desired-state revision, expected-state projection, and expected-state digest equality before admitting the corresponding Azure resource-state readback.

azureResourceStateReadbackPayload.$comment: expectedStateDigest and readbackProjectionRef/readbackProjectionDigest are observations of values pre-bound by the reviewed plan and Azure deployment operation; this record may not originate or redefine them. The semantic validator must resolve the full single-use authorization, ledger-observer, role-binding, and package closure through deploymentOperationRef before VERIFIED admission.

fleetPortfolioCoverage.$comment: The semantic validator must recompute eligible as planned minus excluded, require observed plus missing to equal eligible, and recompute percent as observed divided by eligible times 100. An eligible value of zero is fail-closed and can never carry PASS. Every portfolio and claim PASS must meet the exact governed minimumCoveragePct bound by its enclosing fleet portfolio; caller-supplied status and percent are not evidence. The protected private proof resolver must authenticate a current authorized, non-revoked populationPartitionProof artifact and recompute its exact subject over portfolio/claim scope, snapshot and observation window, privacy-policy and privacy-release refs/digests, counts, all five set commitments, proof scheme/version, commitment key ref/version, canonicalization/version, purpose, and domain digest. It must independently recompute plannedPopulationDigest from the exact protected source population selected by populationCohortRef, join policy/digest, query pack/digest, privacy release/window, and claim-specific source bindings; internal partition consistency is not a source-population anchor. It must prove planned = eligible union excluded, eligible = observed union missing, pairwise disjointness, and exact cardinalities. UTF8_NFC_LENGTH_PREFIXED_SORTED version 1.0.0 requires invariant lowercase source-type canonical identifiers, including canonical GUID form where applicable; rejects invalid identifiers and any value that is not already canonical; applies Unicode NFC; encodes UTF-8; prefixes each identifier with its unsigned byte length; rejects duplicates after canonicalization; sorts by unsigned UTF-8 bytes; and binds the element count. populationCommitmentDomainDigest must canonically bind privacyReleaseRef and privacyReleaseDigest, snapshot, window, exact scope discriminator, purpose, key ref/version, and canonicalization/version; the HMAC key is release/domain-derived so commitments cannot be compared or substituted across releases, claims, cohorts, personas, purposes, keys, or encodings. TEST may use synthetic commitments only while the activation decision remains nonpromotable and Allowed=false; PRODUCTION fails closed when the private resolver, proof, issuer authentication, freshness, authorization, or revocation evidence is unavailable or invalid. Public records contain no member identifiers or proof bytes.

fleetPortfolioClaimBinding.$comment: A dimension status is never sufficient by itself. The semantic validator must resolve every evidenceReleaseBinding specifically to the exact evidence-release-record contentDigest and prove that the release is current, VERIFIED, and contains every claimed source record; it must also resolve every record-and-digest binding, pointer, query pack, artifact hash, fleet-specific governed freshness dependency, and requalification reference. It must prove coverage arithmetic and baseline/window equality; require every T2 claim to resolve current T0/T1 corroboration; and require the dimension machine policy to account for each claimBindingId and exact claimMetricType once. DISTRIBUTION claims must resolve an exact distribution whose Phase 0 sampling-floor binding is current and whose metric, unit, direction, denominator, coverage, source, and window equal this claim. DENOMINATED_COUNT and STRUCTURED_STATE claims must bind a /result projection and digest from the exact summary evidence; counts also bind numerator and recomputed rate, while state claims bind the exact JSON value type. Arbitrary metadata pointers cannot satisfy a claim.

fleetPortfolioDimensionCoverage.$comment: dimensionPolicyDigest is SHA-256 over canonical JSON for the exact ordinal leadership-claim-chain currentFleetRequiredDimensions array. Each dimensionEvidenceDigest is SHA-256 over canonical JSON {dimensionId,status,claimBindings}, excluding only dimensionEvidenceDigest. bindingsDigest is SHA-256 over canonical JSON {dimensionPolicyRef,dimensionPolicyDigest,dimensions:[{dimensionId,dimensionEvidenceDigest}...]} in the frozen 12-dimension order. policyExecutionDigest is SHA-256 over canonical JSON {dimensionPolicyRef,dimensionPolicyDigest,policyExecutionToolRef,policyExecutionToolVersion,policyExecutedAt,bindingsDigest}; policyExecutionRef identifies the immutable execution artifact carrying that projection.

fleetPortfolioPersonaAllocation.$comment: The protected resolver must authenticate populationSubsetProofRef/Digest and prove this privacy-safe observed set is an exact subset of its parent configuration cohort observed set. Across sibling persona rows the sets must be pairwise disjoint, and their union with the parent's committed unassigned set must equal the parent observed set. The proof subject and release-scoped domain bind the parent configurationRef/cohortRef, personaId, counts, privacy policy/release, key, canonicalization, purpose, snapshot, and observation window. Public records contain no member identifiers or proof bytes.

fleetPortfolioConfigurationCohort.$comment: The protected resolver must authenticate populationSubsetProofRef/Digest and prove this configuration cohort observed set is an exact subset of the portfolio observed set. It must authenticate personaPartitionProofRef/Digest and prove sibling persona observed sets plus the committed unassigned set are pairwise disjoint and complete over this configuration observed set. Across sibling configuration cohorts the sets must be pairwise disjoint and configurationPartitionProofRef/Digest on the enclosing portfolio must prove their union equals the portfolio observed set. Proof subjects and release-scoped domains bind configurationRef, cohortRef, counts, set digests, privacy policy/release, key, canonicalization, snapshot, observation window, and purpose. Public records contain no member identifiers or proof bytes.

fleetPortfolioPayload.$comment: The semantic validator must enforce the mutually exclusive reconciliation equations: sourceRecordCount = uniqueDeviceCount + duplicateRecordCount; uniqueDeviceCount = staleDeviceCount + retiredDeviceCount + offlineDeviceCount + unhealthyDeviceCount + joinEligibleDeviceCount; joinEligibleDeviceCount = joinedDeviceCount + unjoinableDeviceCount; joinedDeviceCount = matchedDeviceCount + unmatchedDeviceCount. Configuration cohorts must then reconcile to matchedDeviceCount without duplicate device identity. A protected private resolver must verify privacyPolicyRef/privacyPolicyDigest and privacyReleaseRef/privacyReleaseDigest; resolve privacyAggregationFloorPointer as /aggregationFloor; recompute privacyAggregationFloorDigest; and require aggregationFloor to equal that exact approved scalar. The semantic validator must bind minimumCoveragePointer to /thresholds/minTelemetryCoveragePct/value in the same exact Phase 0 threshold-policy record and digest authenticated by freshnessBinding, recompute minimumCoverageValueDigest, require minimumCoveragePct equality, and recompute all portfolio and claim coverage arithmetic. Eligible zero is fail-closed; no caller PASS overrides the governed minimum. Every selected configuration cohort and persona allocation must meet aggregationFloor, and every applicable claim/cohort must meet minimumCoveragePct. It must resolve every sourceEvidenceReleaseBinding by exact evidence-release-record contentDigest, require each claim evidenceReleaseBinding to be a subset of that exact source set, and prove that every claimed source record and pointer belongs to the bound current VERIFIED release. It must resolve the exact verified leadership-claim-chain currentFleetRequiredDimensions machine policy and its execution artifact, require ordinal equality to all 12 dimension IDs and their complete ordered claimMetricType sets, recompute bindingsDigest and every dimensionEvidenceDigest, and reject generic status-only, missing, invented, duplicated, reordered, stale, or cross-dimension claim bindings.

rolloutMonitoringPayload.$comment: Exactly one governed entry is required for every signal class. NOT_APPLICABLE entries are signed, owned, rationalized, and expiring. The semantic validator must prove primaryAlertRef and independentDeadmanRef resolve to independent delivery and health-check paths and fail closed when the monitor stops reporting.
